question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The greatest source of income in India is _______ from agriculture and related industries.
solution:
The correct answer is "**derived**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, it means that the income is obtained from agriculture and related industries.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use is "derived."**
 
• "Derived" means obtained or produced from something else.(उत्पन्न)
 
 
• Example: The word "man" is derived from the Sanskrit word "manas."
 
 
 
• The sentence structure is passive voice, with "income" as the subject and "derived" as the verb in the past participle form.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (expressed) means communicated or conveyed through words or actions. It is not appropriate in the given context.(व्यक्त)
 
• Option 3 (assumed) means accepted as true or believed without proof. It is not appropriate in the given context.(ग्रहण)
 
• Option 4 (voiced) means expressed or uttered with the voice. It is not appropriate in the given context.(स्वरित)
